text:
emma: Hey folks, starting remote today from UK (emma@remoteworks.pro). I accepted the Okta invite but when I try to enroll a passkey on my iPhone it fails with "device not supported". SMS MFA also isn't coming through (roaming). My Google alias (emma@redwood.dev) didn't appear, so no Drive access and 1Password shows "no license". Can someone help with a temporary access path so I can start the onboarding tasks? :wave:

it-raj: Welcome Emma! Can you DM a backup email for a temp Drive share? For passkey issues we can fall back to TOTP or a temporary FIDO2 token. Which TOTP app do you have? Also we'll open a ticket to check the SCIM/alias mapping for remoteworks.pro -> redwood.dev.

emma: DM'd emma.personal@gmail.com. I have Google Authenticator and Authy. Prefer TOTP for now 12h will be fine.

provision-bot: INC-2899 created by it-raj: "Contractor remoteworks.pro alias + passkey fail + 1Password seat" P2.

devex-lina: I can send a 48h 1Password guest vault link and share the onboarding Drive folder to your personal email. Please don't store long-term secrets in the guest vault. I'll also leave a quick checklist of what you'll need: `GitHub SSH key`, `workstation setup doc`, `initial ticket links`.

it-raj: Shared the Drive folder to emma.personal@gmail.com and added you to the contractors-temp group. Sent a short-lived 1Password guest link via DM.

ops-sam: Quick note on the passkey failure: we've seen iOS devices reject passkey enrollment when the Okta profile has mismatched primary email vs alias. Infra will add a scoped domain mapping for remoteworks.pro and re-run the SCIM sync. ETA 3-5 hours.

emma: Guest link and Drive share both work, thanks! One more question: I need repo access for the starter ticket 56. Who adds me to GitHub org?

it-raj: DM your GitHub handle and public SSH key and we can invite you to the contractors team. If you'd rather use email invites we can send to your personal gmail until the alias is canonical.

provision-bot: INC-2899 status updated  infra assigned (ada-infra). Domain mapping planned, 1Password seat requested from licensing.

devex-lina: Also leaving a small workaround if passkey enrollment matters long-term: enable TOTP in Okta MFA settings, enroll TOTP, then reattempt passkey after SCIM sync. Steps I sent in DM.

emma: DM'd SSH key and handle. I'll use TOTP for now. Appreciate the quick loop-up everyone. :thumbsup:
